title: Motion (General Domestic Relations Motion)
what_it_is: The document that asks the court for a specific order. A motion states the grounds, the authority, and the relief sought, and must be signed (MCR 2.119(A)(1)). It travels with a notice of hearing, and a brief only when it presents an issue of law (MCR 2.119(A)(2)-(3)).
who_reads_it: The judge or referee who will hear it.
The opposing party or their counsel, who is served a copy.
The Friend of the Court, if a child or support is involved (a marked FOC copy, MCR 3.203(G)).
sequence: Draft the motion: numbered material facts, each tied to the legal element it proves (MCR 2.113(B)).
Draft a brief in support only if the motion presents an issue of law (MCR 2.119(A)(2)).
Draft the notice of hearing (may be combined with the motion, MCR 2.119(A)(3)).
Attach any affidavit needed to put facts not already of record before the court (MCR 2.119(B)).
Attach the proposed order (Genesee practice; PROVISIONAL, confirm current LCR 2.119 requirement).
Sign, file, and serve the party and their attorney (MCR 2.107(B)(1); MCR 3.203(I)), then file proof of service (MCR 2.107(D)).
prepare: Confirm whether this is an initial-action pleading or a postjudgment motion in an existing case (MCR 3.204(A)(1); MCR 3.213) - filing the wrong one costs a fee and a hearing date.
Confirm the Genesee concurrence-certificate requirement before filing (PROVISIONAL).
Confirm the current fee or prepare a Fee Waiver Request (MCR 2.002; MCR 2.119(G)).

applicable_rules.summary: A motion must state the grounds, cite the authority, and state the relief or order sought, and be signed as MCR 1.109(D)(3) and (E) provide.
A brief is required when the motion presents an issue of law; it must cite the authority relied on.
A pleading's allegations must be simple, concise, and direct, in numbered paragraphs.
The signature on a motion certifies it is well grounded in fact and law and not filed to harass; violation carries sanctions.

deadlines.label: Response due from the other side

traps.trap: Filing a new complaint when a motion in an existing case was required.
traps.safe_move: Costs a filing fee and a hearing date, and can land in front of a different judge (MCR 3.204(A)(1)).

traps.trap: Vague relief that cannot be enforced.
traps.safe_move: The FOC may decline to enforce a term that is not specific (MCL 552.641(2)(c)). Write the term so it can be broken and proved broken.

traps.trap: Omitting the required UCCJEA affidavit or case inventory.
traps.safe_move: MCR 3.206(A)(3), (B) require these in most custody/parenting-time filings - and any other-state/country fact is a stop-and-verify point (UCCJEA).

traps.trap: Putting a child's name, birthdate, or SSN in a public filing.
traps.safe_move: Redaction is the filer's sole responsibility (MCR 1.109(D)(10)(a)); the child's identifiers do not go beyond what the rule affirmatively requires (GUARDRAILS.md S11a).

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.
Do not label the motion or its exhibits 'filing-ready' without your own final read-through.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Every numbered fact maps to a legal element.
The proposed order's terms are specific enough to enforce (no 'reasonable,' 'as agreed').
Proof of service is prepared to file alongside or immediately after filing.
No child name, birthdate, or SSN beyond what the rule requires.
